bio: Calling all steak lovers! The quality of the meat served here is fantastic, and the perfectly cooked premium steaks, as well as the sauces and side dishes are testament to the skill of the kitchen team. Tip: The cuts are rather large, which makes them ideal for sharing – consider booking for a small group. Adorned with rustic-looking decorative features, the decor is stylish and has an urban feel – the focal point is the open kitchen with its impressive barbecue. This place draws plenty of diners, who receive attentive service from the front-of-house team....
